premises.text: Phone customer service is painful because of holds, spelling personal data, and disconnects
premises.evidence_span: It sucks to wait on hold. It sucks to spell out your name and address. And it really sucks when you get disconnected

premises.text: Caller profiles are delivered to agents via API/widget with priority routing so callers need not re-identify
premises.evidence_span: we send your profile to the answering agent at the time of your call via our API

premises.text: Callers can release billing data with a four-digit PIN instead of reading cards aloud
premises.evidence_span: you simply provide your four-digit billing PIN

premises.text: Contact-center stacks such as Zendesk, Five9, and Salesforce can integrate quickly
premises.evidence_span: Companies using Zendesk, Five9, and Salesforce to manage their call centers can easily integrate

premises.text: Profiles are sold at about $0.10, a large saving versus manual identification cost
premises.evidence_span: We sell our profiles for $0.10. That represents savings of over 90%

premises.text: Telco partnerships supply caller identity coverage without requiring end-user signup
premises.evidence_span: We've partnered with all the major telcos to provide caller information

value.text: Customer service calls without hold and re-identification hassle
value.evidence_span: just customer service without all the hassle
